d['y']=d.year.fillna(d.decade+5); d['late']=d.y>=1876; d['r']=d[c]/d.n_passages
print(d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.agg(['mean','size']).unstack())

  g=df.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); g=g.dropna(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()

print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in ['high','medium']:
  print(dc, est(d[d.date_confidence==dc]) if True else 0)
print('dedupe author', est(d.drop_duplicates('author_key')))
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o, est(d[d.origin==o]))
print('excl near cutoff', est(d[(d.y<1866)|(d.y>=1886)]))
print(d.groupby('decade').r.mean())
